references.text: Another time in the Gospel of John, Peter uses the same gesture (a nod or a sign) to prompt John to ask Jesus about a specific person.
In the Gospel of Matthew, a similar scene occurs where the disciples are deeply grieved and each asks Jesus, 'Is it I, Lord?', reflecting the question about the identity of the betrayer.
Luke also describes the moment when Jesus warns of the betrayal, and the disciples begin to ask one another who it might be that will do this.
